text.tspan: Opportunity Insights at Harvard University used Census Data to track a cohort of children born in 1984-1992 measuring their childhood
locations at age 16 and young adult locations at age 36. This infographic uses that data to gain insights into the patterns of the movement of young
The data is aggregated at the Census Commuting Zone level, which is referred to as "metro area" in the following graphics.
Migration Patterns of Young Adults in America
